entities.summary:
The 120 members of the first Knesset were elected on 25 January 1949. The breakdown by party was as follows:Mapai: 46
Mapam: 19 
United Religious Front: 16
Herut: 14 
General Zionists: 7
Progressive Party: 5
Sephardim and Oriental Communities: 4
Maki: 4 
Democratic List of Nazareth: 2
Fighters' List: 1
WIZO: 1
Yemenite Association: 1
